_note: Generic Germanic base (BASE_01), a single-language Gothic register. Seeded directly by the sim; hybrids emerge from base pairs. CIV/CLAN: Germanic base = Clanhold (kin-reiks and the thing-assembly). Concept: Thiodmark (*theudo-mark, 'people-march') is the generic continental/Gothic Germanic base - migrating war-band kindreds of forest and grassland under thiudans and reiks, dithematic names. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gothic register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Gothic-branch reflexes of the common-Germanic theonym ancestors (family_germanic.json theonym_ancestors, the gothic column), phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Germanic gods. The single-language Gothic register from culture_alani.json is kept separately as the specific Gothic member; this base reuses its lexicon, titles, religion, and names as the generic Germanic seed. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English; conlang titles in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. No approved foreign term applies (Gothic has none on the approved list), so all rulers are English.

phonology.palette: Gothic/continental Germanic: stops + th/dh, w, h; masc -s/-a, fem -o; ai/au diphthongs; dithematic compounds; theophoric stems are the Gothic reflexes (Thulrs-, Erlands-, Numins-, Gauands-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and clusters (st, sk, hl, hr, hw, br); root-initial stress; ablaut.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -sunus or -ing (descendant of); kin (kuni) name for nobility; deed-bynames common.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource|animal](stem) + feature/settlement: Swarta-widus (black-forest), Eisarna-burgs (iron-fort); kin + -ingos (the people of).

title_ladder.government: clanhold (Gothic war-bands and kin-reiks; the gafaurds/thing-assembly is narrative flavor)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Gothic clanhold, ascending, shown in English with Gothic co-titles beneath for dialogue. Built on thiudans (people-king) and reiks (ruler). Gardings (household-lord) barony; Markareiks (march-ruler) march; Kindins (district-governor) county; Drauhtins (war-band leader) duchy; Reiks (great ruler) principality; Thiudans (king) kingdom over a Thiudangardi; Mikilthiudans (great-king) empire. A clan culture rarely climbs past the middle tiers. (Rank titles are the real Gothic register, allowed.)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: personal + -sunus patronymic or kin (kuni); warriors add a deed/animal byname.
people_name_convention.dual_register: reiks-kin carry the clan name + war-epithet; commoners a patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the Gothic deity-reflexes + a Germanic element: -mers (famous), -reiks (ruler), -wulf (wolf): e.g. Thulra-mers, Erlanda-reiks.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Gothic-branch reflexes of the common-Germanic theonym ancestors (family_germanic.json theonym_ancestors, the gothic column) - phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Germanic gods. All three alignments present: Lawful kin keep the high oath-and-sun powers, Chaotic kin the wolf-and-fire powers, Neutral kin the ancestral war-dead and the earth-and-grove powers; the One is distant.
religion.the_one: Aiterns (< *Aiternaz < Aeternus; the distant All-Father, seldom petitioned)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiterns, Thulrs the just, Erlands of the sworn war, Riala the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers skohsla (demons), warded; the war-oath binds and the high gods uphold the kin.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the Anses of the kin) and the earth-and-grove powers - Gauands of the enduring land, the spirits of the alhs-grove - the great powers invoked situationally as the season and the deed require.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the wolf-and-fire kin keep Marahs the War-Fire and the wild powers - and names the Lawful powers, and Aiterns, as the binding-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the opposing powers keep their Gothic reflexes + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power): Maraxus -> Marahs the War-Fire; Vacidus -> Wakiths the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Lusanths the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Alhs (temple / sacred grove) of [power]: 'the Alhs of Erlands'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Anses (deified forebears) honored at the grave-howe; 'the Blessed [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Erlands: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Thulrs: a rayed sun-wheel above the scales

banks_patterns.ships: river-craft and wagon-names (the Thiodmark kindreds are inland): 'the Aurochs', 'Wolf of the Ahwa'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen kin-burgs and grave-howes: 'the Howe of [name]', 'the broken Burgs of [kin]'
